validity.recommendation: Keep as gas/transmission, but note in ResearcherNotes that this is Package 12 lateral/distribution piping (4-16 in), not 56-in MGS trunk; consider PipelineType nuance if GEM distinguishes laterals.
validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: Real and independently corroborated. This is Package 12 of Aramco's Master Gas System Phase III (MGS-3) expansion, awarded to GAS Arabian Services Company. MEED (independent trade publication) explicitly describes the scope: 'Laying 16-inch, 12-inch and 4-inch lateral pipelines in the Eastern Province and Qassim region clusters, covering 116km.' Zawya (independent business wire) separately reports GAS Arabian won an EPC contract for 'Master Gas System expansion in East and Qassim Clusters' worth SAR 416,255,967 (~$111 million), 30-month duration, announced 29 May 2024. Two independent origins agree -> high confidence on existence. Not a GEM-only/hallucinated entity. CLASSIFICATION (caveat): MEED calls these 'lateral pipelines' of 4-16 in diameter, i.e. distribution/lateral feeders within the Eastern Province and Qassim clusters, NOT the 56-in MGS trunk that makes up the other MGS-3 packages (P6717-P6731). Commodity is correctly dry gas (Master Gas System) and recording as PipelineType=transmission is defensible since these are part of the national gas transmission network; flagging only that they are laterals, not trunk. DUPLICATE: Checked against the 65-row Saudi gas roster. GAS Arabian holds two MGS-3 packages -- Package 3 (EWPS-1 -> Shedgum, 56 in, ~56 km) and Package 12 (this Eastern/Qassim lateral, 116 km, 4-16 in). These are distinct routes/diameters, so this row is NOT a duplicate of the EWPS-1/Shedgum segment. P6733 (Riyadh cluster, 470 km, Kalpataru) is a separate package. No relabel/double-count found. ATTRIBUTION: Owner Aramco confirmed (MEED + Zawya both name Aramco as awarding party for the whole MGS expansion; the Aramco.com corporate press release in the existing ref repeatedly ReadTimeout'd and could not be re-verified, but the value is independently supported). Endpoints Eastern Province (start) -> Qassim region (end), Saudi Arabia, confirmed by both sources. SPEC: Length 116 km confirmed by MEED ('covering 116km'). Diameter 12/4/16 in confirmed by MEED ('16-inch, 12-inch and 4-inch'). SegmentCost $111M / SAR 416,255,967 confirmed by Zawya. StartYear 2027 is consistent with a 30-month EPC awarded mid-2024 (~late 2026/2027 completion); plausible but not independently nailed to 2027 specifically -- minor caveat. Status=construction consistent with EPC award. All hard specs corroborated by >=2 independent sources or by the directly-relevant source.
